name: Kitchen Renovation

specs.materials: Quartz waterfall island, matte-lacquer cabinetry, porcelain flooring

projectOverview: A dated, gutted kitchen in a Dubai Marina apartment was rebuilt from scratch: new handleless cabinetry, a waterfall-edge quartz island, integrated appliances and under-cabinet lighting, finished with large-format porcelain flooring.

name: Bedroom Renovation

specs.materials: Walnut-veneer wardrobe, cove LED lighting, painted walls

projectOverview: A bare bedroom with exposed sockets and unfinished walls was turned into a styled suite with a built-in wardrobe, a cove-lit ceiling and an uninterrupted city view.

name: Living Room Renovation

specs.materials: Marble flooring, custom joinery, painted walls

projectOverview: Construction dust and bare concrete gave way to a furnished living room with marble flooring, custom joinery and an uninterrupted Marina skyline view.

name: False Ceiling Installation

specs.materials: Gypsum board, recessed LED strip, integrated downlights

projectOverview: An exposed concrete slab and loose conduit were boxed into a level gypsum ceiling with a recessed lighting cove and integrated downlights.

name: Fitted Wardrobe

specs.materials: Walnut veneer, brushed-brass handles, soft-close hinges

projectOverview: A raw MDF carcass was finished in walnut veneer with brushed-brass handles and soft-close drawers, built to the exact dimensions of the room.

name: Entryway Tiling
projectOverview: Cracked, mismatched tiles in a residential corridor were replaced with large-format polished marble, levelled and finished edge to edge.

name: Villa Dining Room

specs.materials: Walnut dining set, brass chandelier, painted walls

projectOverview: A villa dining room, stripped to bare plaster and exposed wiring mid-renovation, was finished with a walnut dining set, a brass chandelier and fresh paintwork.

name: AC Servicing & Installation

specs.materials: Inverter split unit, new copper piping

projectOverview: A dust-caked, failing split unit was replaced and commissioned with new copper piping, tested and signed off before handover.

name: Electrical Panel Upgrade

specs.materials: New circuit breakers, labelled distribution board

projectOverview: A rusted, undocumented distribution board was rewired, labelled and passed inspection, with every circuit tested before sign-off.
